import asyncio, json, time, statistics
import aiohttp

MODEL="qwen2.5-coder:1.5b-instruct-q4_K_M"
OLLAMA="http://127.0.0.1:11434"

from open_webui.routers.ollama import send_request
from open_webui.utils.json_codec import JSONCodec

def payload(ref):
    return {
        "model": MODEL,
        "messages": [{"role":"user","content":f"Reply with exactly OK. Ref {ref}."}],
        "stream": False,
        "options": {"num_ctx":4096,"num_predict":8,"temperature":0}
    }

def extract(route, ref, wall_ms, body):
    rec={"route":route,"ref":ref,"wall_ms":round(wall_ms,3)}
    if isinstance(body,dict):
        for k in ("total_duration","load_duration","prompt_eval_duration","eval_duration","prompt_eval_count","eval_count"):
            if k in body:
                rec[k+"_ms" if k.endswith("_duration") else k]=round(body[k]/1e6,3) if k.endswith("_duration") else body[k]
        if "error" in body:
            rec["error"]=str(body["error"])[:240]
    return rec

async def direct(session, ref):
    data=json.dumps(payload(ref),separators=(",",":"))
    t0=time.perf_counter()
    async with session.post(OLLAMA+"/api/chat",data=data,headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"},timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=180)) as r:
        body=await r.json()
        status=r.status
    rec=extract("direct",ref,(time.perf_counter()-t0)*1000,body)
    rec["status"]=status
    return rec

async def proxy(ref):
    encoded=JSONCodec.dumps(payload(ref))
    t0=time.perf_counter()
    body=await send_request(
        OLLAMA+"/api/chat",
        payload=encoded,
        user=None,
        stream=False,
        passthrough=False,
        content_type="application/x-ndjson",
        metadata=None,
        api_config=None,
        request=None,
    )
    rec=extract("owui_proxy_impl",ref,(time.perf_counter()-t0)*1000,body)
    rec["status"]=200 if isinstance(body,dict) and "error" not in body else 500
    return rec

async def get_ps(session):
    t0=time.perf_counter()
    async with session.get(OLLAMA+"/api/ps",timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=10)) as r:
        body=await r.json()
    models=[{"name":m.get("name"),"context_length":m.get("context_length"),"expires_at":m.get("expires_at")} for m in body.get("models",[])]
    return {"wall_ms":round((time.perf_counter()-t0)*1000,3),"models":models}

async def main():
    print("BENCHMARK_SCHEMA=owui-ollama-proxy-impl-v1")
    print("LEDGER_SESSION=01a1001d-e1ee-7eb2-a6c4-91d7e19e1075")
    print("MODEL="+MODEL)
    print("SCOPE=direct_ollama_http_vs_installed_openwebui_send_request")
    async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
        print("PS_BEFORE="+json.dumps(await get_ps(session),separators=(",",":")))
        cold=await direct(session,"cold")
        print("COLD="+json.dumps(cold,separators=(",",":")))
        for fn,ref in ((proxy,"warmup-proxy"),(lambda r: direct(session,r),"warmup-direct")):
            rec=await fn(ref)
            print("WARMUP="+json.dumps(rec,separators=(",",":")))
            if rec.get("status")!=200:
                raise SystemExit(20)

        orders=[
            ["direct","proxy"],
            ["proxy","direct"],
            ["direct","proxy"],
            ["proxy","direct"],
            ["direct","proxy"],
            ["proxy","direct"],
            ["direct","proxy"],
            ["proxy","direct"],
        ]
        records=[]
        paired=[]
        for i,order in enumerate(orders,1):
            ref=str(2000+i)
            per={}
            for route in order:
                rec=await (direct(session,ref) if route=="direct" else proxy(ref))
                records.append(rec); per[route]=rec
                print("SAMPLE="+json.dumps(rec,separators=(",",":")))
                if rec.get("status")!=200:
                    raise SystemExit(21)
            paired.append(round(per["proxy"]["wall_ms"]-per["direct"]["wall_ms"],3))

        summary={}
        for route in ("direct","owui_proxy_impl"):
            vals=[r["wall_ms"] for r in records if r["route"]==route]
            srv=[r.get("total_duration_ms") for r in records if r["route"]==route and r.get("total_duration_ms") is not None]
            deltas=[r["wall_ms"]-r["total_duration_ms"] for r in records if r["route"]==route and r.get("total_duration_ms") is not None]
            summary[route]={
                "n":len(vals),
                "min_ms":round(min(vals),3),
                "median_ms":round(statistics.median(vals),3),
                "mean_ms":round(statistics.fmean(vals),3),
                "max_ms":round(max(vals),3),
            }
            if srv:
                summary[route]["ollama_total_median_ms"]=round(statistics.median(srv),3)
            if deltas:
                summary[route]["client_or_wrapper_delta_median_ms"]=round(statistics.median(deltas),3)
        summary["paired_proxy_minus_direct_ms"]={
            "median":round(statistics.median(paired),3),
            "mean":round(statistics.fmean(paired),3),
            "min":round(min(paired),3),
            "max":round(max(paired),3),
            "samples":paired
        }
        print("SUMMARY="+json.dumps(summary,separators=(",",":")))
        print("PS_AFTER="+json.dumps(await get_ps(session),separators=(",",":")))

asyncio.run(main())
PY
